structure.unit: Medical Care Facilities Certificate of Public Need

law.catch_line: Continuing care retirement communities accessing medical assistance

text.section: Nothing in this section shall alter the conditions of a continuing care retirement community's participation in the Medical Assistance Program if that continuing care retirement community was certified for participation prior to July 1, 2010. For the purposes of this section, "open admissions period" means a time during which a facility may take admissions directly into its nursing home beds without the signing of a standard contract.
